sent.label: argumentative
sent.description: This means engaging others in dispute and disagreement as a regular habit.

sent.label: disrespectful
sent.description: This means speaking to others without courtesy and dismissing their dignity.

sent.label: clinical
sent.description: This means observing and assessing situations with detachment, setting aside emotional reactions to see what is actually there.

sent.label: Eastern Orthodox
sent.description: This means practicing the Christian faith through the traditions, liturgy, and theology of the Eastern Orthodox Church.

sent.label: Danish
sent.description: This means being from Denmark or holding Danish citizenship.

sent.label: common
sent.description: This means having no special gifts, rank, or distinction that sets one apart from most people.

sent.label: Junior
sent.description: This means being in the third year of a four-year school or program, past the first two years and with one year still ahead before finishing.

sent.label: ho-hum
sent.description: This means speaking without spark or originality, finding little remarkable in anything.

sent.label: illegal
sent.description: This means breaking laws and rules as a regular practice.

sent.label: full-time
sent.description: This means working at one job for the standard number of hours per week, typically forty or more.

sent.label: integrated
sent.description: This means belonging to a group where one's actions and identity are woven into the fabric of a functioning whole.

sent.label: frosty
sent.description: This means keeping one's distance and showing little warmth toward others in conversation and interaction.

sent.label: high-energy
sent.description: This means moving with vigor and liveliness through one's days, bringing intensity and enthusiasm to whatever one does.

sent.label: lawless
sent.description: This means breaking laws and rules whenever they get in the way, treating regulations and authority as things to ignore and answering only to one's own will.

sent.label: migratory
sent.description: This means moving from place to place or traveling seasonally according to one's needs or patterns.

sent.label: middle
sent.description: This means holding a position between extremes, neither at the top nor the bottom of the order.

sent.label: nonsovereign
sent.description: This means belonging to a territory or group that lacks political independence and answers to an external authority.

sent.label: noncompetitive
sent.description: This means finding satisfaction in participation and effort rather than in defeating others or claiming superiority.

sent.label: part-time
sent.description: This means working fewer than standard hours in one's employment.

sent.label: nonturbulent
sent.description: This means maintaining a steady, composed demeanor that settles rather than unsettles those nearby.

sent.label: pedagogic
sent.description: This means explaining things clearly and patiently, breaking down complex ideas into understandable parts for others to learn.

sent.label: puzzling
sent.description: This means expressing oneself in ways that leave others uncertain of one's meaning or intent.

sent.label: southeastern
sent.description: This means coming from the southeastern region of the United States.

sent.label: Tuscan
sent.description: This means coming from or belonging to Tuscany, a region in central Italy.

sent.label: sophomore
sent.description: This means being in one's second year of formal education.

sent.label: sympathetic
sent.description: This means understanding others' feelings and troubles, and caring about them.

sent.label: raised
sent.description: This means growing up in a particular place and culture, shaped by the values and practices of one's family and community.

sent.label: ungrammatical
sent.description: This means speaking and writing with disregard for standard grammar rules and conventions.

sent.label: unconditioned
sent.description: This means holding positions and making commitments without reservations, exceptions, or contingencies.

sent.label: unobtrusive
sent.description: This means keeping to the background and avoiding actions or speech that would make others look one's way.

sent.label: virulent
sent.description: This means speaking with sharp hostility and deep bitterness toward others.

sent.label: warlike
sent.description: This means approaching conflict with intensity and readiness to fight, seeing opposition as something to overcome rather than avoid.

sent.label: wishy-washy
sent.description: This means holding no strong position on matters and changing one's mind readily when pressed.

sent.label: watertight
sent.description: This means constructing arguments with no logical gaps or weak points that an opponent could exploit.

sent.label: bossy
sent.description: This means giving orders and asserting authority over others as a regular practice.

sent.label: graphic
sent.description: This means speaking with vivid, striking language that creates sharp mental images.

sent.label: linear
sent.description: This means moving from one step to the next in a single straight line, taking each point in order and following one path to its end without detours or side branches.

sent.label: cheeky
sent.description: This means speaking with irreverent humor and pushing back against authority without apology or deference.

sent.label: fickle
sent.description: This means changing one's mind or preferences often without good reason.

sent.label: wily
sent.description: This means using cunning to get ahead, planning several moves out, misleading others with a straight face, and slipping out of tight spots through clever deceit.

sent.label: smug
sent.description: This means regarding oneself as superior and being satisfied with one's own qualities or achievements without doubt or self-examination.

sent.label: nosy
sent.description: This means asking about others' private matters and inserting oneself into situations that do not concern one.

sent.label: pushy
sent.description: This means pursuing one's goals with aggressive force and little regard for others' resistance or comfort.

sent.label: gullible
sent.description: This means believing claims without checking them and falling for deceptions that others would spot.

sent.label: garrulous
sent.description: This means talking on and on at tedious length, piling detail upon detail and tangent upon tangent, and never letting a point end when another sentence can be added.

sent.label: haughty
sent.description: This means carrying oneself with arrogant superiority and scorn for others.

sent.label: shrewd
sent.description: This means seeing through pretense and deception with sharp judgment about people and situations.

sent.label: petulant
sent.description: This means sulking at the smallest setback, whining when things go against one's wishes, and bristling at minor annoyances with a grumbling, wounded air.

sent.label: coy
sent.description: This means affecting shyness or modesty in a playful way, often to draw attention or create intrigue.

sent.label: headstrong
sent.description: This means digging in on every decision, brushing aside advice as soon as it is offered, and treating a changed mind as a defeat to be avoided at any cost.

sent.label: snobbish
sent.description: This means regarding others as inferior in status or taste and treating them accordingly.

sent.label: taciturn
sent.description: This means speaking rarely and in few words, offering silence where others offer speech.

sent.label: engaging
sent.description: This means drawing and holding others' attention through one's presence, conversation, or manner.

sent.label: emotive
sent.description: This means expressing feelings openly and being easily moved by emotional experience.

sent.label: balanced
sent.description: This means keeping one's emotions and judgments steady, without swinging toward extremes.

sent.label: bright
sent.description: This means grasping ideas quickly, seeing connections others miss, and solving problems with mental agility.

sent.label: cold
sent.description: This means keeping others at arm's length, answering with clipped civility, showing no warmth or interest in anyone's feelings, and staying aloof from every attempt at closeness.

sent.label: warm
sent.description: This means greeting everyone with friendliness and real affection, showing care in every exchange, offering encouragement freely, and making others feel welcomed, liked, and at ease in one's company.

sent.label: sharp
sent.description: This means grasping ideas quickly, seeing connections others miss, and thinking clearly under pressure.

sent.label: dense
sent.description: This means taking time to grasp new ideas and following conversations at a slower pace than others.

sent.label: magnetic
sent.description: This means drawing others in without effort, holding attention with a compelling presence and an appeal that makes people want to come closer, listen, and stay.

sent.label: lukewarm
sent.description: This means holding back full commitment and energy from one's undertakings, offering only partial enthusiasm where more is called for.

sent.label: rhetorical
sent.description: This means speaking for effect and persuasion rather than to state what is actually so.

sent.label: prickly
sent.description: This means taking offense quickly and responding with sharp words when displeased.

sent.label: interdisciplinary
sent.description: This means drawing on knowledge and methods from multiple fields to understand and solve problems.

sent.label: anecdotal
sent.description: This means speaking from what one has seen and lived through rather than from studied or organized knowledge.

sent.label: concrete
sent.description: This means focusing on specific facts and practical details rather than abstract ideas or general principles.
